name: Nimzo-Indian Defense
source: Lichess ECO named-line book + Stockfish principal variation
intro: 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Bb4. Black fights for e4 with a piece, accepts a damaged structure if it must, and gets the bishop pair or the two-bishop grip in return. The most reliable sound system against 1.d4.

studies.title: Study 1.1 — 4.Qc2: The Classical Main
studies.keyIdea: White protects c3 and keeps the bishop pair question open. Black answers with ...O-O and ...d5, and the fight is about e4 and the c-file.

tree.commentAfter: Book line ends here — engine-verified top play completes the line to 15 moves for each side.

studies.title: Study 1.2 — 4.Qc2 and the ...d6 setups
studies.keyIdea: When Black delays ...d5 the position becomes a Nimzo with a blocked centre, and the play moves to the c-file and e4.

tree.commentAfter: Book line ends here — engine-verified top play completes the line to 15 moves for each side.

studies.title: Study 2.1 — 4.e3 O-O 5.Bd3 d5
studies.keyIdea: The Rubinstein is the solid main line: Black takes on c3 at the right moment and plays against the doubled pawns.

tree.commentAfter: Book line ends here — engine-verified top play completes the line to 15 moves for each side.

studies.title: Study 2.2 — 4.e3 and the ...c5 strike
studies.keyIdea: Black hits d4 before White is ready, at the cost of a pawn structure that has to be defended accurately.

tree.commentAfter: Book line ends here — engine-verified top play completes the line to 15 moves for each side.

studies.title: Study 3.1 — 4.Nf3: the quiet treatment
studies.keyIdea: White avoids committing the e-pawn. Black equalises with ...b6 and ...Bb7 or with an immediate ...d5.

studies.title: Study 3.2 — 4.f3: the Kmoch and its cost
studies.keyIdea: 4.f3 buys the centre at the price of development. Black answers in the centre immediately.

studies.title: Study 3.3 — 4.Bg5: the Leningrad
studies.keyIdea: White pins the knight and threatens the doubled pawns. Black takes on c3 and plays against the structure.
